SELECT 'catalogued (queryable remotely)' AS scope, count(DISTINCT part) AS parts,
       count(*) AS row_groups, sum(num_rows) AS log_rows,
       round(sum(total_bytes) / 1e9, 1) AS compressed_gb, min(ts_min) AS ts_from, max(ts_max) AS ts_to
FROM otel_row_groups
UNION ALL
SELECT 'indexed locally (full-text)', 1, row_groups, log_rows, round(body_bytes / 1e9, 2), ts_from, ts_to
FROM otel_index_slice

cases.sql:
SELECT ServiceName AS service, count(*) AS log_rows,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(SeverityText) IN ('error', 'fatal')) AS error_rows,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(SeverityText) IN ('warn', 'warning')) AS warn_rows,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(SeverityText) IN ('error', 'fatal')) / count(*), 2) AS error_pct
FROM (
  SELECT ServiceName, SeverityText FROM read_parquet('https://public-pme.s3.eu-west-3.amazonaws.com/text_bench/part_008.parquet', file_row_number = true)
  WHERE file_row_number >= %(lo0)s AND file_row_number < %(hi0)s
) t
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY error_rows DESC, log_rows DESC
LIMIT %(limit)s

SELECT service, log_rows, round(100.0 * log_rows / sum(log_rows) OVER (), 2) AS pct,
       count(*) OVER () AS total_groups
FROM (
  SELECT ServiceName AS service, count(*) FILTER (WHERE TRUE AND lower(SeverityText) = lower(%(severity)s)) AS log_rows
  FROM (
  SELECT ServiceName, SeverityText FROM read_parquet('https://public-pme.s3.eu-west-3.amazonaws.com/text_bench/part_014.parquet', file_row_number = true)
  WHERE file_row_number >= %(lo0)s AND file_row_number < %(hi0)s
  ) t
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE TRUE AND lower(SeverityText) = lower(%(severity)s)) > 0
) g
ORDER BY log_rows DESC
LIMIT %(limit)s

cases.sql:
WITH blocks AS (
  SELECT 45 AS part, file_row_number // 4096 AS block,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE TRUE AND ServiceName = %(service)s) AS n,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE TRUE AND ServiceName = %(service)s AND lower(SeverityText) IN ('error', 'fatal')) AS err
  FROM read_parquet('https://public-pme.s3.eu-west-3.amazonaws.com/text_bench/part_045.parquet', file_row_number = true)
  WHERE file_row_number >= %(lo0)s AND file_row_number < %(hi0)s
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 46 AS part, file_row_number // 4096 AS block,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE TRUE AND ServiceName = %(service)s) AS n,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE TRUE AND ServiceName = %(service)s AND lower(SeverityText) IN ('error', 'fatal')) AS err
  FROM read_parquet('https://public-pme.s3.eu-west-3.amazonaws.com/text_bench/part_046.parquet', file_row_number = true)
  WHERE file_row_number >= %(lo1)s AND file_row_number < %(hi1)s
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
placed AS (
  SELECT b.n, b.err, g.ts_min + (g.ts_max - g.ts_min) *
         ((b.block * 4096 - g.first_row)::DOUBLE / g.num_rows) AS ts
  FROM blocks b JOIN otel_row_groups g
    ON g.part = b.part AND b.block * 4096 >= g.first_row AND b.block * 4096 < g.first_row + g.num_rows
)
SELECT date_trunc('minute', ts) AS bucket, sum(n)::BIGINT AS log_rows, sum(err)::BIGINT AS error_rows
FROM placed
GROUP BY 1
HAVING sum(n) > 0
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT %(limit)s

         count(*) FILTER (WHERE TRUE) AS n,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE TRUE AND lower(SeverityText) IN ('error', 'fatal')) AS err
  FROM read_parquet('https://public-pme.s3.eu-west-3.amazonaws.com/text_bench/part_024.parquet', file_row_number = true)
  WHERE file_row_number >= %(lo0)s AND file_row_number < %(hi0)s
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
placed AS (
  SELECT b.n, b.err, g.ts_min + (g.ts_max - g.ts_min) *
         ((b.block * 4096 - g.first_row)::DOUBLE / g.num_rows) AS ts
  FROM blocks b JOIN otel_row_groups g
    ON g.part = b.part AND b.block * 4096 >= g.first_row AND b.block * 4096 < g.first_row + g.num_rows
)
SELECT date_trunc('minute', ts) AS bucket, sum(n)::BIGINT AS log_rows, sum(err)::BIGINT AS error_rows
FROM placed
GROUP BY 1
HAVING sum(n) > 0
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT %(limit)s

cases.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN TRUE AND lower(SeverityText) = lower(%(severity)s) THEN regexp_replace(regexp_replace(left(Body, 300), '[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}', '<uuid>', 'g'), '0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|\b[0-9a-fA-F]*[0-9][0-9a-fA-F]*\b', '<*>', 'g') END AS pattern,
       ServiceName AS service, lower(SeverityText) AS severity,
       count(*) AS log_rows, count(*) OVER () AS total_patterns
FROM (
  SELECT ServiceName, SeverityText, Body FROM read_parquet('https://public-pme.s3.eu-west-3.amazonaws.com/text_bench/part_047.parquet', file_row_number = true)
  WHERE file_row_number >= %(lo0)s AND file_row_number < %(hi0)s
) t
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
HAVING pattern IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY log_rows DESC
LIMIT %(limit)s

SELECT hit AS file_row_number, ts, ServiceName, SeverityText, SpanId, body,
       count(*) OVER () AS total_matches
FROM (
  SELECT CASE WHEN TraceId = %(trace)s THEN file_row_number END AS hit,
         any_value(Timestamp::TIMESTAMPTZ) AS ts, any_value(ServiceName) AS ServiceName,
         any_value(SeverityText) AS SeverityText, any_value(SpanId) AS SpanId,
         any_value(left(Body, 300)) AS body
  FROM read_parquet('https://public-pme.s3.eu-west-3.amazonaws.com/text_bench/part_000.parquet', file_row_number = true)
  WHERE file_row_number >= %(lo)s AND file_row_number < %(hi)s
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING hit IS NOT NULL
) t
ORDER BY file_row_number
LIMIT %(limit)s
